title: Atlas DataFlow Dataset Public Profile Snapshot Evidence
description: Reduced, deterministic traceability evidence for a single published profile snapshot, produced by registry/dataset_public_profile_snapshot_evidence.py and written alongside registry/profile-snapshots/<dataset_slug>.json. Mirrors publisher/evidence.py's and pipeline/evidence.py's established reduced-evidence-writer convention. Must never carry raw runtime logs, raw API payloads, secrets, or embedded repository file contents. The visibility_at_publish_time value is a read-only capture of registry/datasets.json's existing public_metadata.visibility field and must never be treated as this evidence's own authoritative source for that field.

dataset_slug.title: Dataset Slug
dataset_slug.description: Must match the published snapshot's own dataset_slug.

snapshot_identifier.title: Snapshot Identifier
snapshot_identifier.description: Deterministic composite identifier derived from dataset_slug and published_at, never a randomly generated identifier.

published_at.title: Published At
published_at.description: Must match the published snapshot's own published_at.

active_release_at_publish_time.title: Active Release At Publish Time
active_release_at_publish_time.description: Must match the published snapshot's own active_release_at_publish_time. Reference only, not release artifact content.

path.title: Draft Path
path.description: The private draft profile source this snapshot was published from.

candidate_validation.title: Candidate Validation
candidate_validation.description: Reduced accept/reject validation outcome already computed by publish_snapshot's own schema/reference validation. Never raw jsonschema exception payloads or file contents.

visibility_at_publish_time.title: Visibility At Publish Time
visibility_at_publish_time.description: Read-only capture of registry/datasets.json's existing public_metadata.visibility value for this dataset_slug at publish time. Not a redefinition, mutation, or new authoritative source for that field.
